summary: Completed public-preview backend and frontend regression testing for Demo Shop, dashboard, voice commands, inventory, settings, profile routes, help, and responsive navigation.

critical.issue: Login returns a JSON bearer token but no application httpOnly access cookie is set, and logout only returns {ok:true} without revoking the still-valid token. This does not meet the auth playbook's cookie/session expectations.

minor.issue: PUT for a nonexistent product returns HTTP 200 with null instead of 404. DELETE also returns success when nothing was deleted.
ProductIn defaults minimum_stock to 5 regardless of the shop's saved default_low_stock_threshold setting.

ui_bugs.issue: Low stock, Out of stock, and Reorder suggestions buttons are rendered but do not change the displayed list/filter.
Success copy always says stock was added, including after a STOCK_OUT/sold command.

integration_issues.flow: New product defaults after Settings threshold save
integration_issues.issue: The threshold persists visually and after refresh, but add-product form/backend still hardcode minimum stock 5 instead of using the saved threshold.

issues: Sidebar opens over the page without a visible scrim or close control; the underlying inventory content appears visually clipped while the drawer is open.

action_items: Implement the intended session strategy: secure httpOnly cookie or explicitly document bearer-only auth, and revoke/clear sessions on logout.
Use the persisted shop default_low_stock_threshold when initializing and validating newly added products.
Wire Alerts tabs to actual low/out-of-stock/reorder filters.
Make voice success text conditional on STOCK_IN versus STOCK_OUT.
Return 404 for product update/delete when the product does not exist.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS is configured as allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False; this is incompatible with a cookie-based auth strategy and should be replaced with explicit configured origins if cookies are enabled.
The frontend has no catch/error state around profile, shop, settings, reset, or delete mutations, so failed API calls can leave users without actionable feedback.
seed_data_creation: Demo Shop was used. Regression tests created and removed one TEST_ product; browser checks created a temporary Test Turmeric product and changed demo shop/settings data, so use Reset demo data before another clean demo run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo login, dashboard seed/stats, parser (Rice, Oil rendu, stock-out), confirmation-before-mutation, persistence, overdraw rejection, manual product/search, profile routes, help, settings refresh, and mobile nav were exercised. Re-test auth session behavior, alert tabs, threshold application, and stock-out success copy after fixes.
rca of the issue: The threshold mismatch is caused by ProductIn.default=5 and the Inventory form's initial minimum_stock=5 being independent of the shop settings document. Alert tab controls have no state or filtering handlers in Alerts. Auth is bearer-token-only: login serializes token JSON, logout does not invalidate it, and CORS is wildcard/non-credentialed.
